# netbox_inventory_item_template (Resource)

Manages a NetBox inventory item template (`/api/dcim/inventory-item-templates/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_inventory_item_template" "example" {
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.

### Optional

- `component_id` (Number) Component Id.
- `component_type` (String) Component Type.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the Manufacturer (`netbox_manufacturer`).
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the Inventory Item Template (`netbox_inventory_item_template`).
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer-assigned part identifier. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the Inventory Item Role (`netbox_inventory_item_role`).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_inventory_item_template can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_inventory_item_template.example 123
```
